title: WINDOWS VISTA AERO VS LINUX UBUNTU BERYL
summary: A 2007 side-by-side demo comparing Windows Vista's Aero interface with Ubuntu running Beryl/Compiz, showing effects such as the desktop cube and burning windows.
why: HN commenters cite it as the widely seen nostalgic video from the era when Linux desktop effects outpaced Vista.

quote.text: I remember watching it and being awed by the cube effect.
